comments.text: Level 2 glyph pixels for character codes 0 through 127, eight rows per glyph. $CAA6 indexes this charset when testing a hull overlap.
Level 2 glyph pixels for character codes 128 through 255. The solid-character mask at $8024 uses these codes as well as those in the lower half.

The four level 2 mask banks at $5800, $5880, $5900 and $5980 each hold 128 bytes. $CAA6 selects a base from $11E6/$11EA and adds eight times the hull cell index before comparing with terrain glyph pixels.
Two 128-byte mirrored hull masks. At $5A00 the shape mirrors the $5800 mask around the midpoint between pixels 11 and 12. At $5A80 it is shifted two pixels right.
Level 2 CHARS payload tail. The loop at $C969 copies the entire page to $6F00 before level setup reuses these addresses. The file supplies 255 bytes of the page.
Level 2 header, the little-endian addresses $9BF4 and $9C43 of the low and high sprite offset tables. $CDB1 writes them into the operands at $DCA3 and $DCA8.
Level 2 scroll-direction sequence. Starts at 1, contains 20 entries of 1, 8 of 2 and 3 of 3, and ends in 0. The initial direction is read at $CC6A and subsequent entries at $9E28.

Level 2 solid-character mask. Index this 32-byte table with the character code shifted right 3, then test the bit from $1457 indexed by the low three bits. The shot and hull tests read it at $2FCF and $CA8E.
